text:
thomas_prod: I redeemed a promo via the CLI (CLI-NEWYEAR) and the command returned 200, but our org balance still shows 0. org: acme-data (org_4587). anyone seen this?

maria_support: sorry about that — can you paste the exact command/response you used so we can repro? also which org id in the CLI?

thomas_prod: sure. used the infra laptop, command below. response body said accepted.

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"code":"CLI-NEWYEAR","org_id":"org_4587"}'
```

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"accepted","message":"redeem queued","redeem_id":"rd_98765"}

maria_support: thanks — that looks normal. tagging billing. @eli_billing can you check if rd_98765 shows up in the ledger/ingest queue?

eli_billing: looking now. I see a webhook event for rd_98765 at 2024-07-12T14:05:10Z that acknowledged the redeem. However ledger.write failed with: 

[ERROR] ledger/write rd_98765 -> DB insert failed: insert into credits (id, org_id, amount, source) values (...) FAILED: FK constraint "billing_accounts_org_id_fkey"

Seems the org had no linked billing_account_id in billing.accounts at the time, so the credit write aborted. The redeem service still returned 200 because webhook ingestion succeeded; we didn't fail fast on ledger write.

thomas_prod: ah that might be it — we recently detached billing for a migration. org currently has billing_account = null. what do we need to do to get the credit applied?

eli_billing: quick remediation options: 1) re-run the ledger job after linking a billing account, 2) manually create a credit row for org_4587, or 3) issue a one-off ad hoc grant via console. I'll run option 2 while we make the pipeline safer.

sophie_eng: logging/alerting follow-up: redeem worker should surface ledger write failures back to API caller or at least surface a retry queue. I'll PR a change to return a 202+redeem_id and also instrument retry on FK errors.

eli_billing: actioned — I manually inserted a credit row for org_4587: +1000 trial units, source=promo CLI-NEWYEAR, ledger_id=lg_2045. You should see the balance update in ~30s. I also queued rd_98765 for a retry so the system state is consistent.

thomas_prod: confirmed — balance updated to +1000 and usage view reflects it. thanks! :tada:

maria_support: marking this one resolved from support side. root cause: orphaned promo redeem due to missing billing_account triggered FK failure on ledger write. remediation: manual credit + retry; follow-ups: eng to adjust redeem pipeline to detect missing billing_account and surface clearer error to CLI (and prevent silent accept).

promo_bot: INFO: created internal ticket #BR-7643 to: (a) add pre-check for billing_account presence during redeem; (b) return 4xx if precondition fails; (c) backfill tool for orphaned redeems.

eli_billing: also adding a short-term alert to billing writes that fail with FK constraint to P0 so we catch these earlier.

thomas_prod: appreciate the fast turnaround. leaving this thread open for the follow-up ticket until the pipeline change is merged.

maria_support: noted — we'll keep the ticket open. thanks for reporting and for the quick repro steps.
